ontology.name: artisan_bakery_local
ontology.description: Operations ontology for a neighborhood bakery: catalog, customers, inventory, purchasing, invoicing, and fulfillment.

types.name: CurrencyCode
types.description: Three-letter uppercase ISO-style code used for currency and code fields.

types.name: Email
types.description: Email address string validated with a basic local@domain pattern.

types.name: Money
types.description: Non-negative monetary amount used for prices, totals, and balances.

types.name: PhoneNumber
types.description: Phone number string supporting optional leading plus and separators.

types.name: Quantity
types.description: Non-negative quantity used for inventory counts and ordered amounts.

values.name: Issued
values.description: Initial status after the invoice has been issued.

values.name: Paid
values.description: Status after the invoice has been fully paid.

values.name: Overdue
values.description: Status when payment is past due and outstanding.

enums.name: PurchaseOrderStatus

values.name: Draft
values.description: Initial state while purchase details are still being prepared.

values.name: Submitted
values.description: Status after the purchase order has been sent to the supplier.

values.name: Received
values.description: Status after ordered goods have been received.

values.name: Closed
values.description: Final status once the purchase order lifecycle is complete.

enums.description: Lifecycle status for a purchase order.

enums.name: SalesOrderStatus

values.name: PendingPayment
values.description: Initial status while payment is still outstanding.

values.name: Paid
values.description: Status after full payment has been recorded.

values.name: Fulfilled
values.description: Status after order items have been delivered or completed.

values.name: Cancelled
values.description: Terminal status for orders cancelled before completion.

enums.description: Lifecycle status for a sales order.

actions.name: adjustInventory
actions.description: Applies a direct quantity adjustment to an inventory item.

actions.name: cancelSalesOrder
actions.description: Cancels an unpaid sales order and emits the cancellation details.

actions.name: closePurchaseOrder
actions.description: Closes a received purchase order after post-receipt tasks complete.

actions.name: createPurchaseOrder
actions.description: Creates a purchase order for supplier replenishment.

actions.name: createSalesOrder
actions.description: Creates a sales order, computes totals, and returns linked billing references.

actions.name: fulfillSalesOrder
actions.description: Marks a paid sales order as fulfilled.

actions.name: markInvoiceOverdue
actions.description: Marks an unpaid invoice as overdue.

actions.name: markInvoicePaid
actions.description: Marks an invoice as paid once payment is confirmed.

actions.name: markSalesOrderPaid
actions.description: Marks a sales order as paid and emits payment details.

actions.name: receivePurchaseOrder
actions.description: Marks a submitted purchase order as received.

actions.name: recordInvoicePayment
actions.description: Records invoice payment details and emits a payment-recorded event.

actions.name: registerCustomer
actions.description: Creates and returns a new customer profile for bakery operations.

actions.name: restockInventory
actions.description: Updates inventory quantities based on received purchase orders.

actions.name: submitPurchaseOrder
actions.description: Submits a draft purchase order to the supplier.
